07 / How I work

A simple process.
A sharper result.

Good content starts before the first sentence. I research the opportunity, build the structure, write for real readers and refine the piece using what the data tells us.

01 | RESEARCH

Find the angle

Research the topic, audience, search intent, competitors and timely talking points.

02 | STRUCTURE

Build the story

Turn research into a clear outline with logical sections, useful takeaways and natural keyword placement.

03 | WRITE

Make it readable

Write in a human, engaging voice while keeping accuracy, clarity and SEO fundamentals intact.

04 | PUBLISH

Polish + ship

Format, proofread and publish on WordPress or prepare supporting content for promotion and backlinks.
